# Conyso Mart

> A distributor that brings new Indian food brands to small towns, starting with Paonta Sahib (Sirmaur district, Himachal Pradesh). It delivers them free the same day if you order by 6 pm on WhatsApp, and you pay cash or UPI on delivery. It is part of Conyso (conyso.com).

Facts on these pages come from the brands' own websites and pack labels, each with its source. Prices are the printed MRP, incl. of all taxes.

## Brand directory (42 Indian food brands, sourced)

- [All brands](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brands.html)
- [A to Z](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brands-a-z.html)
- [Anveshan](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-anveshan.html): Ghee, wood-pressed oils, atta and other staples.
- [Beyond Snack](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-beyond-snack.html): Kerala banana chips in a range of flavours.
- [Bhuira Jams](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-bhuira-jams.html): Handmade fruit preserves, jams, jellies, marmalades and chutneys from Himachal Pradesh.
- [Bombay Banta](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-bombay-banta.html): Indian-flavoured sodas such as masala soda, kala khatta and shikanji.
- [BRB](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-brb.html): Popped (neither fried nor baked) chips, baked toasties and peanut-butter wafers.
- [EAT Better Co](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-eat-better-co.html): Snacks including sweets and laddoos, namkeens, and seed and nut mixes.
- [Farmley](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-farmley.html): Flavoured dry fruits and nuts, roasted makhana, date bites and snack mixes.
- [GO DESi](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-go-desi.html): Desi snacks and sweets such as jaggery candy pops, fruit bars, chips and regional sweets.
- [Healthy Master](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-healthy-master.html): Non-fried snacks such as ragi, oats, beetroot and high-protein chips, plus dry fruits and nuts.
- [Hector Beverages (Paper Boat)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-hector-beverages.html): Paper Boat traditional Indian drinks, Zero Sugar sparkling water, chikki and dry fruit trail mixes.
- [Indian Snack House](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-indian-snack-house.html): Regional South Indian sweets and savoury snacks such as halwas, palkova, murukku, banana chips and jaggery sweets, plus gift boxes.
- [Indusland Foods](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-indusland-foods.html): Seeds (chia, flax, sunflower, pumpkin), jaggery balls and plain and flavoured roasted makhana.
- [Jade Forest](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-jade-forest.html): Low-sugar non-alcoholic drinks and mixers such as tonic waters, ginger ale and ready-to-drink beverages.
- [Let's Try](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-lets-try.html): Indian snacks such as namkeens, chips, ladoos, chikki and cookies made without palm oil or maida.
- [MasterChow](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-masterchow.html): Ready-to-cook Asian food: cooking sauces, noodles, chilli oils and pantry staples.
- [Millet Amma](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-millet-amma.html): Millet-based foods including batters, mixes, grains, flours, pizza base, lavash and cookies.
- [Minchy's](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-minchys.html): Himalayan pickles, chutneys, jams, juices, squashes, honey and vinegars.
- [MOM (Meal of the Moment) and Gimi Gimi](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-mom-gimi-gimi.html): Instant meals and snacks such as roasted makhana under MOM, and Korean-style noodles under Gimi Gimi.
- [NoCap Foods](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-nocap-foods.html): Palm-oil-free chips and namkeen made with oats, millets, moong dal and vegetables such as beetroot, carrot and spinach.
- [Nutty Gritties](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-nutty-gritties.html): Dry fruits, roasted nuts, and nut, seed and berry mixes.
- [Nuvie](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-nuvie.html): Ready-to-drink protein milkshakes and protein bars.
- [Open Secret](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-open-secret.html): Snacks including nutty cookies, baked vegetable chips, dry fruits and nuts, namkeen, cereals and gift hampers.
- [Oroos](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-oroos.html): Packaged sweets and confectionery, priced for mass-market buyers across India.
- [Peping](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-peping.html): Prebiotic fizzy drinks and probiotic shots.
- [ProV](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-prov-foods.html): Dry fruits, nuts, seeds and flavoured makhana in snack packs.
- [Rockit](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-rockit.html): Low-priced energy drinks, starting with a berry-flavoured Rockit Energy.
- [Sattviko](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-sattviko.html): Flavoured makhana snacks, millet puffs, instant meals, trail mixes and nuts.
- [SFA Beverages](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-sfa-beverages.html): Fruit drinks sold under brands such as Fruit4U and Mango Smile.
- [Slurrp Farm](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-slurrp-farm.html): Millet-based snacks and foods for children.
- [Snackible](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-snackible.html): Everyday snacks such as chips, popped chips, millet snacks, cookies, dips and spreads.
- [SOBER](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-soberr-beverages.html): Distilled non-alcoholic spirits (whiskey, rum, gin and pink gin alternatives), plus non-alcoholic canned cocktails and flavoured waters.
- [Supply6](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-supply6.html): Daily nutrition products such as all-in-one nutrient sachets, hydration salts, fibre mixes, plant protein and meal mixes.
- [Sweet Karam Coffee](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-sweet-karam-coffee.html): South Indian sweets and snacks, filter coffee, condiments and ghee.
- [TagZ Foods](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-tagz-foods.html): Popped potato chips, dips and centre-filled cookies.
- [The Whole Truth](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-the-whole-truth.html): Packaged foods including protein bars, protein powders, energy bars, muesli and nut butters.
- [To Be Honest (TBH)](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-tbh.html): Crunchy snacks made from real vegetables and fruit, such as sweet potato, chickpea, jackfruit and banana crunchies.
- [Troo Good](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-troo-good.html): Millet snacks, chiefly millet chikkis and millet bars.
- [True Elements](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-true-elements.html): Breakfast and snack foods such as oats, muesli, granola, seeds, seed mixes, trail mixes and dry fruits.
- [Upperi](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-upperi.html): Kerala banana and tapioca chips made with Nendran bananas and fried in rice bran oil.
- [WellBe](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-wellbe-foods.html): Snacks with no added preservatives (chips, chivda, makhana, traditional snacks) plus kitchen staples such as cold-pressed oils, organic grains, flours and spices.
- [WickedGud](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-wickedgud.html): Noodles and pasta made from whole wheat, lentils, oats, chickpeas and other grains, with no maida.
- [ZOFF Foods](https://krishnachagti-sudo.github.io/conyso-mart/brand-zoff-foods.html): Whole, powdered and blended spices, plus dry fruits and whole food products.
